DZ-SS10/001EN
Legend of the Celestial Fury, Estacion
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[ACT](VC)[1/Turn]:If you have a Blast token, when a Plant token would be placed on (RC) by this effect, put it face up as your Blast token's plant gauge instead. [COST][Counter-Blast 1], you call up to one Plant token to (RC), look at the top three cards of your deck, choose a card from among them, put it into hand, and shuffle the deck. If you have six or more plant gauges, look at the top five cards instead of three cards. (You can look at five cards if the gauge becomes six cards by this effect)
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][discard two plant gauges], search your deck or drop for up to one <Blast>, call it to (RC), and if you searched the deck, shuffle the deck.
